newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS MONACO HELD TO A 2-2 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS MONACO HELD TO A 2-2 DRAW.

text.p: Caen prevented Monaco from celebrating their French title in style when they held them to a 2-2 draw on Sunday.
Monaco were assured the championship 24 hours earlier when their nearest rivals Paris St Germain drew 2-2 with Bordeaux.
After a dull first half, Monaco moved up a gear to the relief of their fans and scored in the 53rd minute through Nigerian Viktor Ikpeba.
Caen's equaliser 10 minutes later came from a brilliant strike by Frederic Nee.
Substitute Thierry Henry restored Monaco's lead in the 74th minute but Caen's Stephane Roche equalised almost immediately.
The draw restored Monaco's nine-point lead over PSG with two matches to play.
Cannes drew 2-2 with Strasbourg on Sunday to virtually guarantee themselves first division soccer next season while Strasbourg, winners of the League Cup, have already qualified for the UEFA Cup.
